notes: RQ1 processes only the Claude run under unpacked_raw_data/claude.
Only test case optimization requirements are included: test case selection and test case minimization.
pass@k is computed over planned runs from unpacked_raw_data/claude/experiment_runs.jsonl.
Runs without unpacked trace data are retained with null wall-clock_time/tokens; their success fields come from experiment_runs.jsonl.
Mean and std for wall-clock_time and tokens exclude null values.
req_size.char_count is the number of characters in the matching UTF-8 requirement text file, excluding a UTF-8 BOM if present.
No approximation-ratio metric is generated here because the requested RQ1 JSON schema does not include solution-quality fields and the available traces do not provide a uniform ground-truth optimum.
